verdict.rationale: Cursor provides an Agents Window/Cloud Agents dashboard where multiple parallel cloud agents can be launched, tracked, and managed across repos ('run as many agents as you want in parallel'), plus worktrees for isolated concurrent local sessions, subagents for parallel delegation, and automations/webhooks for background fleets — all documented as a unified workspace an engineering lead can oversee. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on account of a lead actually coordinating multiple engineers' agent sessions in one shared dashboard, and no evidence of cross-session visibility/analytics tailored specifically to a lead role beyond general team analytics APIs.
